lines.zh: 长发拖到腰后，我一步步走。
lines.en: Long hair to my waist, I walk one step at a time.
Each step makes the ground answer.
Lightning crawls along my arms.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，草全伏下去。
lines.en: I fly low and the grass lies flat.
This form is heavy. I cannot move fast.
I step closer and he steps back.

lines.zh: 气从我身上溢出来，挡不住。
lines.en: Ki spills off me and will not be contained.

lines.zh: 我绕过那堵墙，继续往前。
lines.en: I round that wall and keep going.

lines.zh: 石子在脚边跳，被气托着。
lines.en: Pebbles hop by my feet, held on my aura.

lines.zh: 我不需要速度，力就够了。
lines.en: I need no speed. Force will do.

lines.zh: 长发拖地，我踩碎脚下石板。
lines.en: Hair dragging the ground, I crush the flagstones underfoot.
The wind parts around me.

lines.zh: 我站着，气把周围都压低了。
lines.en: I stand and my aura presses everything down.

lines.zh: 长发在气里飘，我懒得拨。
lines.en: My long hair drifts on the aura. I leave it.
I push my long hair out of my eyes.

lines.zh: 这个形态，连呼吸都很重。
lines.en: In this form even breathing is heavy.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，电流在指间绞。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the current twists between fingers.
The stone under me has gone hot.

lines.zh: 长发垂到腰，气把它吹起来。
lines.en: My hair hangs to my waist; my ki lifts it.
He will not come closer. I wait.

lines.zh: 这一形态的力量，我还没用尽。
lines.en: I have not spent this form's strength yet.
I try to draw the ki in. It will not go.

lines.zh: 风停了，空气开始噼啪响。
lines.en: The wind stopped and the air begins to crackle.

lines.zh: 我看他的时候，他退了半步。
lines.en: When I look at him, he takes half a step back.
My shoulders are running hot.

lines.zh: 这里没有能挡住我的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing here that can stop me.
Look carefully. This is the third stage.

lines.zh: 这个形态，我不打算久留。
lines.en: I do not intend to stay in this form.

lines.zh: 你还能站在这里，很难得。
lines.en: That you still stand here is rare.

lines.zh: 我的气已经把空气挤开了。
lines.en: My aura has pushed the air aside.
Do you hear the current?

lines.zh: 别看我的头发，看我的手。
lines.en: Do not watch my hair. Watch my hands.
Get farther away before I raise my hand.
I dislike drawn-out fights.

lines.zh: 你的指节发白，藏也没用。
lines.en: Your knuckles have gone white; hiding it is pointless.

lines.zh: 你的气在我面前像烛火。
lines.en: Your ki is a candle flame before me.
I will not pull this punch.

lines.zh: 站在那儿不动，是怕了吗。
lines.en: Standing frozen there, are you afraid.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，现在是这个颜色。
lines.en: My eyes are this color now.
Whoever is behind you, all at once.
Amid the crackle, I only count to two.

lines.zh: 这个形态下，我很不耐烦。
lines.en: In this form my patience is short.
Your feet are drifting left.
My patience is short; when I finish counting, I move.

lines.zh: 大魔界的风，也吹不散我的气。
lines.en: Not even the Demon Realm wind scatters my ki.

lines.zh: 我抹掉嘴角的血，没说话。
lines.en: I wipe the blood from my lip without a word.
In this form my wound smokes.
It hurts. The ki holds.
I straighten and the current still sings.
The armor split. The man remains.
The wound smokes, and my aura still burns.
I clamp my ki and hold the blood in.

lines.zh: 我的身体在提醒我时间不多。
lines.en: My body reminds me time is short.
It is not finished.

lines.zh: 这东西，对现在我没意义。
lines.en: That means nothing to me now.

lines.zh: 气太强，连味道都烧掉了。
lines.en: The aura is so strong it burns the smell away.

lines.zh: 我闻不到，只听见自己的气。
lines.en: I smell nothing, only my own ki roaring.
Take it further off. Not at my feet.
In this form I do not want to eat.

lines.zh: 等变回来，我要吃两倍的量。
lines.en: When I change back I will eat twice as much.

lines.zh: 这点食物，撑不住这个形态。
lines.en: That much cannot sustain this form.
One sniff and I turn away.
Do not roast things in front of me.
I said it: after the fight.
You hit me and bounced off.
In this form I cannot be touched.
The current will bite. Move back.
Stay back. I lift a foot and the ground splits.
You cannot shift even my aura.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你退了四步。
lines.en: One step from me, four from you.
That is not worth looking down for.
Get out of the way. Do not dawdle.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我要走的方向。
lines.en: You are in the direction I am going.
Once you have bumped, keep your feet.

lines.zh: 这个样子，我不想让任何人看见。
lines.en: I do not want anyone to see me like this.

lines.zh: 长发和电光，不适合回家。
lines.en: Long hair and lightning do not belong at home.

lines.zh: 我答应过要回去，就一定会回。
lines.en: I promised I would return, so I will.
This form wears the body. I know.
Such words I do not say aloud.

lines.zh: 家里的灯还亮着，我记着。
lines.en: The lamp at home is still lit. I remember.

lines.zh: 她要是看见我这样，会骂我。
lines.en: If she saw me like this she would scold me.

lines.zh: 我把气收回一点，好说话。
lines.en: I draw my ki in a little so I can speak.
This power is not for show.
When this is done I will explain.

lines.zh: 我伸手，东西自己浮上来。
lines.en: I reach out and the thing floats up to me.

lines.zh: 这块石头在我手里碎了。
lines.en: The stone crumbles in my grip.
One squeeze and the iron bends.

lines.zh: 地上的东西被气托起来。
lines.en: My aura lifts what lies on the ground.
I look, and I am not interested.
This will scorch in my hand.
I toss it back. Too light.
One small orb. I keep it.
What falls is mine.
I need not bend. It saves effort.
His ki flickered.
I have seen his opening.
This distance. One step.
The thunder drowns out my steps.
He raised his arm and I moved at once.
Can he stop the first blow?
I have locked onto his chest.
His footwork leans right.
I want this over in one strike.
He shouted. Loud.

lines.zh: 不在于他多强，而在我多快。
lines.en: It is not his strength. It is my speed.
My hand rises, the ki already full.
From this angle he cannot block.
He begins to retreat. Too late.
I press ki into my feet.

lines.zh: 目标就一个，不必要第二个。
lines.en: One target. No second needed.
I wait for him to spend himself.
His breaths are getting shorter.

lines.zh: 这一招我三秒就看穿了。
lines.en: I read that in three seconds.
He keeps running around the rocks.
I do not chase. Let him come.
This form burns me. I must be quick.
He raises a guard above.
The current hisses in the air.
I slide half a step.
He is watching my feet.
He has backed behind a pile of rock.
That pile breaks under one kick.
His aura has come apart.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人三，头发都竖着。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 3, hair standing straight.
He looks up to find me.
I am above him and he does not know.
This strike comes from behind him.
One more beat, then I move.

lines.zh: 我一闪消失，再出现时已经打到。
lines.en: I vanish and reappear with the blow already landed.

lines.zh: 终极闪光从我手中轰出。
lines.en: Final Flash roars out of my hands.

lines.zh: 致命连舞般的拳脚压下去。
lines.en: A lethal chain of fists and feet comes down.

lines.zh: 加利克炮擦着他的肩膀过。
lines.en: The Galick Gun grazes his shoulder.

lines.zh: 大爆炸攻击在近处炸开。
lines.en: Big Bang Attack bursts at close range.
I kick him into the sky.

lines.zh: 电流顺着我的拳打进他身体。
lines.en: Current rides my fist into him.
He guards high and takes it on the ribs.

lines.zh: 我抓着他的头发往下拽。
lines.en: I seize his hair and haul him down.

lines.zh: 气弹连射，一串跟着一串。
lines.en: Ki bolts, one chain after another.
My knee drives into his chest.

lines.zh: 他还没落地，我已经到了。
lines.en: He has not landed and I am already there.
This one drives him into the earth.

lines.zh: 他的武器被我的气震飞了。
lines.en: My aura blasts the weapon out of his hands.
I raise my hand and the beam punches through.
He falls and his ki still smokes.
Lightning comes down and I am there.

lines.zh: 长发垂到腰，气浪往外推。
lines.en: Hair to my waist, the shockwave pushes outward.
The ground is pressed into a circle.

lines.zh: 我踩在空气上，慢慢落下。
lines.en: I settle down slowly on the air.

lines.zh: 这个形态，连天空都变色。
lines.en: Even the sky changes color in this form.
Lightning circles me.
The rubble all floats up.

lines.zh: 我出场的时候，没有声音。
lines.en: My arrival makes no sound.
The air feels ready to ignite.
I raise my eyes and everything darkens.
I rarely use this form.
I land and the soil sinks.
The aura spreads above my head.
I have not moved and the wind has fled.
I let my hands hang and wait.

lines.zh: 这是最后一阶，也是最后一次警告。
lines.en: The final stage, and the final warning.
Everything in the distance is shaking.
The lightning fades, and I take one step.

lines.zh: 火焰扑上来，我的气挡掉了大半。
lines.en: Flames rushed in and my aura ate most of it.

lines.zh: 我从高空砸下来，地陷了很深。
lines.en: I slam down from height and the ground sinks deep.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的气也沉了。
lines.en: Water pours in and even my aura sinks.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪掀开了我身边的地。
lines.en: The blast wave tore the ground from under me.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸打穿了我的袖子。
lines.en: A shot punched through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这股力量按住了我的气。
lines.en: This force is holding my ki down.

lines.zh: 身体撑不住这个形态了。
lines.en: My body can no longer carry this form.
Sky lightning ran through me.

lines.zh: 我被扯进没有气的地方。
lines.en: I am pulled into a place without ki.
